description: Figure 3(a) illustrates the Bit-per-Character (BPC) metric on the validation dataset during the training phase for the SMoE routing policy, as reported for Mistral [27]. The x-axis represents “Training Steps,” scaled in units of 10³, ranging from 0 to 50 (i.e., 0 to 50,000 steps), with major tick marks at intervals of 10 (10,000 steps). The y-axis displays the BPC value on a linear scale, ranging from 1.2 to 2.2, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. Two lines are plotted: a black solid line labeled “SMoE Validating” and a magenta dashed line labeled “SimSMoE Validating.” Both lines begin near a BPC of 2.2 at 0 training steps and exhibit a steep decline in the first 10,000 steps. After approximately 20,000 steps, both lines flatten and converge to a stable BPC value near 1.2, with the SimSMoE line consistently slightly below the SMoE line across the entire training duration, indicating marginally better validation performance.
